# nextgenergy.ai — crawler policy
# Retrieval, search and answer engines are welcome to index and cite this site.
# Content Signals (contentsignals.org): search and AI answers yes; use of this content to train models no.

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

# Explicitly welcome (retrieval / citation): OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User,
# ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Googlebot, Bingbot, DuckAssistBot, YouBot, Applebot,
# Baiduspider, Sogou web spider, Bytespider, 360Spider, YisouSpider.

# Machine-readable summaries for language models:
# https://nextgenergy.ai/llms.txt
# https://nextgenergy.ai/llms-full.txt
# Every article also exists as Markdown at /insights/<slug>.md

Sitemap: https://nextgenergy.ai/sitemap-index.xml
